baseline.method: Qualified original TV: independent IMU/newK, normalized clock and corrected two-dimensional flow indexing; real IJRR boxes window

numerical_tolerance_rationale: independent deterministic rerun 0; seconds/milliseconds final difference 6.86e-13; general backend tolerance 1e-6 fixed before evaluation
observation_residual_definition: norm(D image - c b)/norm(D image), c=max(0,dot(D image,b)/dot(b,b)); b is public motion-compensated NIWE; zero directional norm is assigned residual1
nrmse_definition: RMS error divided by reference dynamic range, no alignment
v2_definition: Preserve original directional observation residual limit, require source unit-range percentile gauge and centered-difference anisotropic TV no larger than validated standard plus1e-8relative numeric allowance. No hidden map comparison or finite split-Bregman recipe.
